assertions.requirement: Cursor info, references, rename, and semantic tokens agree on the authored token span for a source-backed template member.
Cursor-locus queries that accept line and character resolve the same semantic member as offset-aware queries for the same source position.
Unproven weak/dynamic member references return only proven rows, preserve candidates separately, and mark the answer open.
App-level diagnostic aggregation preserves the template diagnostic subject, selected member identity, suggestion action, source, and domain.
Edit-bearing template code actions carry explicit oldText and validate insertion/replacement text against authored source.

assertionSets.requirement: Public app-query catalog rows preserve the cursor/source-file/paging/materialization boundary that IDE, MCP, and contract callers use to choose safe query shapes.
Template semantic tokens preserve exact authored token spans for Aurelia syntax and expression surfaces.
Paged template semantic tokens preserve exact authored spans for plugin syntax, controllers, router resources, and composition resources.
Template folding ranges and inlay hints preserve authored source spans and distinguish implicit helper hints from explicitly authored syntax.
Bindable property and explicit public-attribute alias surfaces preserve distinct references and rename edit plans.
Explicit custom-element resource references and rename plans use exact public-name declaration and tag-token sources.

Resource registration rows preserve framework registration identity, author-facing taxonomy, declaration carrier forms, aliases, and exact public-name sources across custom elements, custom attributes, template controllers, value converters, and binding behaviors.
Runtime resource registration collisions publish framework-owned resource issue rows with AUR0153-AUR0156 codes and source spans on the duplicate registration carrier.
Template diagnostics preserve diagnostic kind, missing-input vocabulary, selected symbol, suggestion action, and authored source.
Compiler diagnostics preserve framework-code vocabulary and authored source ownership.
Missing plugin capability diagnostics preserve the concrete framework capability and authored syntax source.
Template overlay diagnostics preserve TypeScript code identity while retaining authored template source and semantic subject spans.
Template completions preserve binding-scope visibility, checker member metadata, and Aurelia hook facts without losing state-projected owner types.
Template code actions distinguish safe edit plans from diagnostic-only suggestions and preserve exact edit provenance, oldText, and action affordance metadata.

Framework capability demand rows preserve the capability key, admission/actionability state, module recommendation, authored syntax source, and related diagnostic lane before presentation diagnostics are assembled.
Template-controller scope constructs preserve Aurelia binding-context, override-context, branch-local, parent-scope, resource, diagnostic, and edit-plan semantics through public query answers.

Router topology rows preserve route configs, path patterns, residual endpoints, route-recognizer state, nested route contexts, parameter/query aggregation, and viewport/component-agent handoffs as pre-transition static facts.

Router RouteContext topology distinguishes static potential contexts from selected transition rows, preserves viewport-agent/used-by source facts, and spends resolved custom-element names where Aurelia RouteConfigContext and ViewportAgent semantics require them.

Router load.context overrides are RouteContext ownership boundaries: static instruction closure must publish an exact open seam rather than guessing which IRouteContext will own the viewport instruction tree.

fields.summary: Load router resource has a context override; semantic-runtime does not yet remap router instruction ownership across dynamic IRouteContext values.

assertionSets.requirement: Router framework resources expose precise cursor surfaces for load/href/au-viewport and their bindables, complete router-specific completions, and conservative references/rename refusal when the selected resource is framework-owned rather than workspace source-backed.

Router instruction values preserve route-world closure through cursor facts, completions, diagnostic projections, and honest gaps where the route substrate knows more than the current IDE-facing surface exposes.

Router resource instructions close literal and statically reduced internal routes, preserve dynamic route holes honestly, keep external href escapes out of router ownership, and avoid diagnostics for genuinely open values.

assertionSets.requirement: String routeable components resolve through Aurelia resource visibility, including aliases and dependency-scoped duplicate names, without reporting router issues.

Router route config products preserve Aurelia's declaration forms, normalized value shapes, routeable component lanes, route-recognizer handoff paths, and honest gaps where source-backed routeable identity is known but not yet spent.

Router diagnostics preserve owning product lanes, framework error codes/raw authorities, issue phases, and authored source spans across recognizer grammar, instruction parsing/creation, route recognition, redirect, viewport, eager path, and config-validation failures.

AuCompose runtime composition rows preserve component/model/template resolution posture, recursive resource analysis context, activation handoff evidence, and static framework-error diagnostics without claiming live hydration.
